turns.prompt_text: show me some items and prices of 22 gauge copper wire
turns.response_html: Prices for 22-gauge copper wire vary based on type, length, and bulk. You can find solid bare copper wire for as low as $0.09 per foot and insulated stranded wire for around $0.40 per foot. Rolls can cost between $7.00 for a 4 oz. spool and over $200 for a 500 ft. spool.
